rationale: This is clearly an auto collision with damage to the policyholder's vehicle caused by another motor vehicle and injuries sustained by the policyholder in the impact.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at 8:15 AM yesterday on Route 9 while stopped at a red light. The other vehicle was traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking, causing catastrophic damage to the trunk and back seat of the policyholder's vehicle (totaled). Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; other driver's insurance information is available on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling at 35 mph with no braking; trunk crushed into back seat
